secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (sb_secret_...) from your Supabase project Dashboard → Settings → API → service_role secret. Needed for admin/server-side operations. A development placeholder is generated so the app boots; replace it with the real key to enable admin features.

secrets.name: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID
secrets.description: Optional: Twilio Account SID for SMS appointment notifications. From Twilio Console dashboard.

secrets.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional: Twilio Auth Token for SMS appointment notifications. From Twilio Console dashboard.

secrets.name: TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER
secrets.description: Optional: Twilio phone number to send SMS from. From Twilio Console → Phone Numbers.
